Hi Samantha / Alex,

Thanks again for the demo earlier, appreciate the time. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on procurement/commercial path before we kick off the extended trial: 

What we discussed:
- Trial scope: 2 teams (Search & Summarization), up to ~50k tokens/day across both teams.
- Success criteria: 1) 95th pct latency < 350ms for typical queries, 2) precision baseline for summarization at or above current model, 3) integration with your VPC (if required) by end of trial.
- Expected start: as early as 7/20 if procurement clears.

Procurement/commercial questions we need to confirm from your side:
1) Will Acme purchase via PO (net 30) or corporate card?
2) Are you interested in marketplace listing (AWS Marketplace) or direct contract?
3) Any specific SOW/contract language we should prepare (data residency, audit logs)?

Next steps from us:
- I'll follow up with a short SOW + pricing quote for the trial-to-paid path (card vs PO scenarios).
- Rishi will scope dedicated capacity options if you expect sustained throughput after trial.
- If procurement prefers PO, we can prepare a standard master services agreement + SOW and send to procurement@acme.com for review.

Can you confirm procurement preference and an internal billing start target (if procurement needs time, we can start trial now and set billing to begin when you flip to paid)?

Thanks,

Thanks Marissa, great session. Quick answers from our side: 

1) Procurement preference: We prefer PO / Net 30 for anything > $5k/month. For smaller pilots they typically use corporate card, but for multi-team trials we'll likely go PO.
2) Marketplace: We prefer a direct contract for enterprise terms; marketplace is fine for quick proofs but procurement wants direct for tracking and SLAs.
3) SOW language: Please include audit logging, SOC2 evidence reference, and standard data processing addendum (DPA). We can provide a template if helpful.

On success criteria, I've looped Alex (engineering lead) to confirm the 50k tokens/day target is realistic. Alex, can you confirm by Thursday?

Samantha
